arxiv-2112-08174.title: Quantum Noise of Gravitons and Stochastic Force on Geodesic Separation
arxiv-2112-08174.creator: H. T. Cho, B. L. Hu
arxiv-2112-08174.description: Abstract In this work we consider the effects of gravitons and their fluctuations on the dynamics of two masses using the Feynman-Vernon influence functional formalism, applied to nonequilibrium quantum field theory and semiclassical stochastic gravity earlier by Calzetta, Hu and Verdaguer CalHu94 ; CalHu08 ; HuVer20 , and most recently, to this problem by Parikh, Wilczek and Zahariade PWZ20 ;

arxiv-2202-12010.title: Theoretical methods for excitonic physics in two-dimensional materials
arxiv-2202-12010.creator: M. F. C. Martins Quintela, J. C. G. Henriques, N. M. R. Peres
arxiv-2202-12010.description: Abstract In this tutorial we introduce the reader to several theoretical methods of determining the exciton wave functions and the corresponding eigenenergies. The methods covered are either analytical, semi-analytical, or numeric. We make explicit all the details associated with the different methods, thus allowing newcomers to do research on their own, without experiencing a steep learning curve.

arxiv-2210-01976.title: An extended version of the Cayley-Hamilton-Ziebur Theorem Thanks: ∗ Research partially supported by CNPq # 303039/2021-3, Brazil
arxiv-2210-01976.creator: Flank D. M. Bezerra ∗, Lucas A. Santos
arxiv-2210-01976.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to prove a Cayley-Hamilton-Ziebur Theorem for non-autonomous semilinear matrix differential equations. Moreover we show the applicability of results like these to ODE theory. Mathematical Subject Classification 2020: 34A12; 34A30 Key words and phrases: Cayley-Hamilton-Ziebur Theorem; non-autonomous semilinear systems; characteristic polynomial; ordinary differential equations; fractional powers. 1.

arxiv-2311-16600.title: Morphisms of Cuntz–Pimsner algebras from completely positive maps Thanks: The authors thank Kylie Fairhall for tex-mex advice, and Menevse Eryüzlü for sharing her constructions [ Ery22 ] . K.A. Brix was supported by a Carlsberg Foundation Internationalisation Fellowship and a DFF-International postd
arxiv-2311-16600.creator: Kevin Aguyar Brix, Alexander Mundey, Adam Rennie
arxiv-2311-16600.description: Abstract . We introduce positive correspondences as right C ∗ C^{*} -modules with left actions given by completely positive maps. Positive correspondences form a semi-category that contains the C ∗ C^{*} -correspondence (Enchilada) category as a “retract”. Kasparov’s KSGNS construction provides a semi-functor from this semi-category onto the C ∗ C^{*} -correspondence category.

arxiv-2312-10858.title: Variable Importance in High-Dimensional Settings Requires Grouping
arxiv-2312-10858.creator: Ahmad Chamma, Bertrand Thirion, Denis Engemann
arxiv-2312-10858.description: Abstract Explaining the decision process of machine learning algorithms is nowadays crucial for both a model’s performance enhancement and human comprehension. This can be achieved by assessing the variable importance of single variables, even for high-capacity non-linear methods, e.g. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs).

arxiv-2401-03075.title: Non-Hermitian Dirac theory from Lindbladian dynamics
arxiv-2401-03075.creator: Y. M. P. Gomes
arxiv-2401-03075.description: Abstract This study investigates the intricate relationship between dissipative processes of open quantum systems and the non-Hermitian quantum field theory of relativistic fermionic systems. By examining the influence of dissipative effects on Dirac fermions via Lindblad formalism, we elucidate the effects of coupling relativistic Dirac particles with the environment and show the lack of manifest Lorentz invariance.

arxiv-2412-01895.title: CO 2 -rich protoplanetary discs as a probe of dust radial drift and trapping
arxiv-2412-01895.creator: Andrew D. Sellek, Marissa Vlasblom, Ewine F. van Dishoeck
arxiv-2412-01895.description: Abstract Context. Mid-infrared spectra indicate considerable chemical diversity in the inner regions of protoplanetary discs, with some being H 2 ​ O \text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{O} -dominated and others CO 2 \text{CO}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} -dominated. Sublimating ices from radially drifting dust grains are often invoked to explain some of this diversity, particularly with regards to H 2 ​ O \text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{O} -rich discs. arxiv-2511-20070.title: Rings in which one-sided strongly π \pi -regular elements are strongly π \pi -regular
arxiv-2511-20070.description: Abstract In 1977, Hartwig and Luh asked if a a is an element of a Dedekind-finite ring S S , then does a ​ S = a 2 ​ S aS=a^{2}S imply S ​ a = S ​ a 2 Sa=Sa^{2} . This question was answered negatively by Dittmer, Khurana, and Nielsen in 2014.

britannica-1911-afzelius-adam.title: Afzelius, Adam (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-afzelius-adam.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-afzelius-adam.description: Article 'Afzelius, Adam' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. His brother, Johann Afzelius (1753–1837), known as Arvidson, was professor of chemistry at Upsala; and another brother, Per Af (1760–1843), who became professor of medicine at Upsala in 1801, was distinguished as a medical teacher and practitioner.

pmc-10623795.title: Exploring microproteins from various model organisms using the mip-mining database
pmc-10623795.creator: Bowen Zhao, Jing Zhao, Muyao Wang, Yangfan Guo, Aamir Mehmood, Weibin Wang, Yi Xiong, Shenggan Luo, Dong-Qing Wei, Xin-Qing Zhao, Yanjing Wang
pmc-10623795.description: Microproteins, prevalent across all kingdoms of life, play a crucial role in cell physiology and human health. Although global gene transcription is widely explored and abundantly available, our understanding of microprotein functions using transcriptome data is still limited. To mitigate this problem, we present a database, Mip-mining (https://weilab.sjtu.edu.cn/mipmining/), underpinned by high-quality RNA-sequencing data exclusively aimed at analyzing microprotein functions.

pmc-10747743.title: Divergent Retention of Sucrose Metabolism Genes after Whole Genome Triplication in the Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
pmc-10747743.creator: Yang Xu, Zhuping Yao, Yuan Cheng, Meiying Ruan, Qingjing Ye, Rongqing Wang, Guozhi Zhou, Jia Liu, Chaochao Liu, Hongjian Wan, Vagner A Benedito
pmc-10747743.description: Sucrose, the primary carbon transport mode and vital carbohydrate for higher plants, significantly impacts plant growth, development, yield, and quality formation. Its metabolism involves three key steps: synthesis, transport, and degradation. Two genome triplication events have occurred in Solanaceae, which have resulted in massive gene loss.

pmc-11574562.title: Development of a Serum Metabolome‐Based Test for Early‐Stage Detection of Multiple Cancers
pmc-11574562.creator: Rajnish Nagarkar, Mamillapalli Gopichand, Suparna Kanti Pal, Ankur Gupta, Najmuddin Md Saquib, Ahmad Ahmad, Ganga Sagar, Kanury V S Rao, Zaved Siddiqui, Imliwati Longkumer
pmc-11574562.description: BackgroundDetection of cancer at the early stage currently offers the only viable strategy for reducing disease‐related morbidity and mortality. Various approaches for multi‐cancer early detection are being explored, which largely rely on capturing signals from circulating analytes shed by tumors into the blood.

pmc-11615751.title: Genome‐Wide Profiling of H3K27ac Identifies TDO2 as a Pivotal Therapeutic Target in Metabolic Associated Steatohepatitis Liver Disease
pmc-11615751.creator: Yaling Zhu, Limeng Shang, Yunshu Tang, Qiushuang Li, Lin Ding, Yi Wang, Tiantian Zhang, Bin Xie, Jinhu Ma, Xinyu Li, Shuwen Chen, Xinrui Yi, Jin Peng, Youfeng Liang, Anyuan He, Hong Yan, Huaqing Zhu, Buchun Zhang, Yong Zhu
pmc-11615751.description: H3K27ac has been widely recognized as a representative epigenetic marker of active enhancer, while its regulatory mechanisms in pathogenesis of metabolic dysfunction‐associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) remain elusive. Here, a genome‐wide comparative study on H3K27ac activities and transcriptome profiling in high fat diet (HFD)‐induced MASLD model is performed.

pmc-11710571.title: Whole genome methylation sequencing identifies sex‐specific DNA methylation levels in late onset dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11710571.creator: Phillip E Bergmann, Andy Madrid, Ligia A Papale, Coleman Breen, Lindsay R. Clark, Sanjay Asthana, Sterling C. Johnson, Sündüz Keles, Kirk J. Hogan, Reid S Alisch
pmc-11710571.description: BackgroundLate onset dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease (AD) has a sex‐biased incidence with females comprising nearly two thirds of all cases. Females have a more rapid progression in cognitive decline and higher levels of known AD biomarker pathology compared to men.

pmc-11716465.title: Comparing neural activity of older adults with and without Parkinson’s disease using mobile electroencephalography in different environments
pmc-11716465.creator: Samantha Marshall, Gianna Jeyarajan, Jennifer Hanna Al‐Shaikh, Raphael Gabiazon, Tia Seleem, Lindsay S Nagamatsu
pmc-11716465.description: BackgroundParkinson’s disease is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that is becoming more prevalent as the population ages. Mobile neuroimaging has made it possible to observe cortical activity in this population outside of standard laboratory environments. Yet, few studies have explored the portability of these devices in a true real‐world environment without a specific task imposed on participants (e.g.

pmc-12527820.title: Successful Treatment of Vulvar Lichen Sclerosus Using Microfiltered and Preconditioned Suspension of Autologous Adipose‐Derived Stem Cells With Photothermal Biomodulation: A Case Report
pmc-12527820.creator: Paolo Mezzana, Hernán Pinto
pmc-12527820.description: Vulvar lichen sclerosus is a chronic, inflammatory, autoimmune mucocutaneous disease characterized by hypopigmentation, skin sclerosis, and atrophy. Injections with microfiltered and preconditioned suspension of autologous adipose–derived stem cells are well tolerated and reduce symptoms and skin sclerosis without side effects or technical complications. Results are valid for 5 months after treatment (follow‐up period).

pmc-12692832.title: Study on the Fatigue and Healing Characteristics of Steel Slag Asphalt Concrete
pmc-12692832.creator: Heng Yuan, Haofeng Zheng, Hao Huang, Liantong Mo
pmc-12692832.description: The fatigue healing mechanisms of steel slag asphalt concrete remain unclear and involve complex influencing factors. When used as an asphalt pavement material in actual road engineering projects, there is a risk of significant deviations in fatigue life predictions and insufficient stability in long-term service performance. In this study, traditional diabase asphalt concrete was used as a reference.

pmc-13070347.title: Carbon Dots Derived from Ligusticum chuanxiong Alleviate Acute Kidney Injury by Scavenging ROS and Restoring Mitochondrial Homeostasis
pmc-13070347.creator: Sen Liu, Siyao Sun, Hang Li, Hongli Zhou, Xiangfei Cui, Shiyan Ruan, Yong Liu, Yao Tong, Miaomiao Lu
pmc-13070347.description: PurposeAcute kidney injury (AKI) is a severe clinical condition with high morbidity and mortality that lacks effective therapies. Carbon dots (CDs) derived from traditional Chinese medicine ingredients have emerged as promising therapeutic agents because of their favorable biosafety profile and potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.

pmc-13412541.title: IL‐22Rα1 restrains pancreatic injury independently of its C‐terminal STAT3‐amplifying domain
pmc-13412541.creator: Léna Puigdevall, Clara Stewardson, Lysa Dhulst, Emilie Hendrickx, Laure Dumoutier
pmc-13412541.description: Interleukin‐22 (IL‐22) is a cytokine that regulates tissue inflammation and repair, primarily through activation of STAT3 signaling. Although its protective effects in acute pancreatitis (AP) are well established, the specific contribution of its receptor, IL‐22Ra1, and the underlying signaling mechanisms remain incompletely defined.

pmc-13561122.title: Dirofilaria immitis in Panama City: first molecular detection with public health implications
pmc-13561122.creator: K. González, A. Pérez, C. Aguilar, A. Valderrama
pmc-13561122.description: SummaryThis report details a fatal case of canine dirofilariasis with concomitant Ehrlichia canis infection, emphasizing the role of molecular diagnostics and highlighting diagnostic and epidemiological gaps in Panama, particularly regarding stray dogs as key foci of infection. An 8-year-old mixed-breed dog presented with severe clinical signs, including adult nematode expectoration, lymphocytosis, eosinopenia, anemia, and thrombocytopenia.

pmc-13619670.title: A Discrete Choice Experiment of Clinician Preferences Among Attributes of Approved Janus Kinase Inhibitors for Alopecia Areata
pmc-13619670.creator: James Q Del Rosso, David Pariser, Neal Bhatia, Kathleen L Deering, Qing Harshaw, Victoria Barghout, Thomas J Ferro
pmc-13619670.description: IntroductionAs the treatment landscape for alopecia areata (AA) expands, it is crucial to understand how treatment properties impact clinician decision-making. The objective of the study was to understand how clinicians treating AA make decisions and evaluate the relative importance (RI) of treatment attributes.
